title: Database Push
description: Push schema changes to remote database

dryRun.description: Print the SQL that would be executed without applying

linkedProject.description: Project ref to push to (overrides linked project)

password.description: Database password (uses SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD env var if not provided; the env var only applies to the linked project)

yes.description: Answer yes to all CLI prompts (required for hosted changes in non-interactive runs such as CI)
